rules.name: Synaptic Imperatives
rules.description:
At the start of the battle round, until the end of the battle round:
  Choose one of the following (Synaptic Imperative):
    - Friendly units within 6" have a 5+ invulnerable save.
    - Add 1 to the Advance rolls of friendly units within 6"; add 1 to the Charge rolls of friendly units within 6".
    - Add 1 to the Hit rolls of friendly units within 6" with melee weapons.

rules.name: Surprise Assault
rules.description:
You can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly TYRANIDS models.
Each time a friendly BURROWER unit ends an Ingress move, place a tunnel marker (40mm) within 1" of the triggering unit and more than 3" horizontally away from all enemy units.
When a friendly unit arrives from Strategic Reserves during the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, you can use this ability: the triggering unit can be set up on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a tunnel marker more than 6" away from all enemy models.
Each time an enemy model (excluding AIRCRAFT models) ends a move, while the triggering model is within 3" of a tunnel marker, remove that tunnel marker from the battlefield.

rules.name: Leader-beasts
rules.description:
Friendly units with the TYRANID WARRIORS WITH MELEE BIO-WEAPONS or TYRANID WARRIORS WITH RANGED BIO-WEAPONS keyword gain the BATTLELINE and TYRANID WARRIORS keywords.
Friendly models with the TYRANID PRIME WITH LASH WHIP, TYRANID WARRIORS or WINGED TYRANID PRIME keyword have a 5+ invulnerable save.

rules.name: Enraged Behemoths
rules.description:
While the attacking unit is below its Starting Strength, add 1 to friendly MONSTER TYRANIDS models' Hit rolls.
While the attacking unit is Below Half-strength, add 1 to friendly MONSTER TYRANIDS models' Wound rolls.
While a friendly MONSTER TYRANIDS unit is not Battle-shocked, unless that unit is below its Starting Strength, improve that unit's Objective Control characteristic by 2.

rules.name: Insurmountable Odds
rules.description: After an enemy unit shoots, during your opponent's Shooting phase, if this unit lost one or more models to those attacks, friendly ENDLESS MULTITUDE units can make a Surge move of up to D6".

rules.name: Questing Tendrils
rules.description:
If this unit has the TYRANIDS keyword:
  - This unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
  - If this unit has the VANGUARD INVADER keyword, this unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

rules.name: Vanguard Prime
rules.description: Friendly DEATHLEAPER units lose the Hunter Organism ability.

rules.name: Hyper-adaptations
rules.description:
At the start of the battle round, during the first battle round, for the rest of the battle:
  Choose one of the following (Hyper Adaptations):
    - Against INFANTRY or SWARM targets, friendly TYRANIDS models' weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
    - Against MONSTER or VEHICLE targets, friendly TYRANIDS models' weapons gain [LETHAL HITS].
    - Against CHARACTER targets, if the triggering hit roll was a critical, friendly TYRANIDS models' weapons gain [PRECISION].

rules.name: Feed the Swarm
rules.description:
During your Command phase, if this unit has the HARVESTER keyword:
  - Select one friendly TYRANIDS unit within 6" of this model (each unit can be selected for this ability at most once per phase across your army):
    Choose one of the following (Regenerate):
      - One model in that unit regains up to D3+1 lost wounds.
      - Unless the selected unit has the ENDLESS MULTITUDE keyword, return 1 destroyed INFANTRY model (excluding CHARACTER models) to that unit, each with its full wounds remaining; if the selected unit has the ENDLESS MULTITUDE keyword, return 3 destroyed models to that unit, each with its full wounds remaining.

rules.name: Mindhunger
rules.description:
Friendly units with the DEATHLEAPER, LICTOR or NEUROLICTOR keyword gain the Deep Strike ability.
Against CHARACTER targets, you can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly units with the LICTOR or NEUROLICTOR keyword.

rules.name: Higher Imperatives
rules.description: During the Command phase, friendly units with the NORN EMISSARY or NORN ASSIMILATOR keyword resolve the Singular Purpose ability now.
